Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to suspend either my Digimon or my opponent's Digimon?
Can I activate this card's inherited effect when an opponent's Digimon and this Digimon are deleted at the same time?

Effect: When this card would be played from the hand, if you have [Yuuko Kamishiro] or a [CS] trait Digimon, reduce the play cost by 3.

[On Play] [When Digivolving] By suspending 1 Digimon, until your opponent's turn ends, their effects can't return 1 of your Digimon with [Vegetation], [Plant] or [Fairy] in any of its traits or the [CS] trait to hands or decks.
Inherited Effect: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon deletes your opponent's Digimon in battle, trash their top security card.
